quotes.text: When ... for some time [a season] Literally, "There were days. . . ." Hebrew yamim may indicate indefinite time4 or "a year." In the latter case, as their confinement ended on the royal birthday, their offenses could have been committed in connection with the celebration of the preceding birthday, as Shadal suggests.

quotes.text: The chief steward [captain of the guard] That is, Joseph's own master, on whose estate the prison was situated. The cupbearer later characterizes Joseph as "a servant of the chief steward.
